title: Keep the internal keys' limit in the config file?

questions.question: Keep the internal keys' limit in the config file, as below?
questions.context:
One test sent 700 requests a minute with an internal key. Rather than raise the limit in code, the limits move to `config/limits.toml`:

```diff
--- a/config/limits.toml
+++ b/config/limits.toml
@@ -1,3 +1,5 @@
 [rate_limit]
-per_minute = 120
+customer_per_minute = 120
+internal_per_minute = 600
+burst = 20
 refill = "1s"
```
